## Workload

Nadia Qureshi graded 1085 sets during 488 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.2 sets per hour. The workload record provides the basis for assessing the volume completed during the review period and indicates that grading activity was maintained across the available rostered time.

## Quality

A sample of 79 graded sets was read again as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 72.2 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the workload information when reviewing grading performance and identifying any areas requiring further attention. No further action is proposed this quarter.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
